title: See, the reality of Modi ji's jumalas
description: In the last 1 year, people have realized that like the government, education of the country is also going on without policy. asr.full_text: Friends, in the last year you have also felt that the National Sikh Policy has been kept free from any pressure. The new National Sikh Policy, which has been launched with big claims, has been completed by one year. In the last year, people have realized that there is no national education policy in the country. During the last year, most schools, colleges and universities were closed. During this period, the new education policy was gradually implemented. If the new Sikh policy was as good, then the Union Sikh Minister Ramesh Pokhriyal Nishakh had resigned. Why Dharmendra Pradhan has been made the new Sikh Minister. In the last year, people have realized that the government's approach to education in the country is also going without a policy.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents political commentary comparing claims associated with Modi with depicted education-related conditions. Its speech and description criticize the implementation and claimed results of the National Education Policy, while the frame supports a claim-versus-reality presentation. The subscription request is ordinary channel promotion and is not connected to payment, investment, private information, or another deceptive participation flow.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is political commentary on education policy and school conditions, a general public-affairs subject rather than a financial, reward or service participation flow.
